scripts.build: turbo run build && bun -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; if (fs.existsSync('apps/web/dist')) fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });" && bun build api/serverless.ts --target=node --outfile=api/[...path].js --external fastify --external "@fastify/*" --external "@libsql/*" --external nodemailer
scripts.vercel-build: turbo run build && bun -e "import fs from 'node:fs'; if (fs.existsSync('apps/web/dist')) fs.cpSync('apps/web/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true });" && bun build api/serverless.ts --target=node --outfile=api/[...path].js --external fastify --external "@fastify/*" --external "@libsql/*" --external nodemailer
